messages:
maya: Quick: we need a compact "inspector" view for autofallback decisions. Operators should see mode, trigger, quota impact, and a way to preview sampled requests without flipping anything. cc @liam @sarah
liam: Love an inspector. UX: single-line status chip on rollout card; click opens a right-hand drawer with sample traffic, top signals, and a small 'dry-run' toggle.
sarah: 'sample-only' mode is crucial. Let the inspector show estimated token change (monthly) and a tiny timeline of last 6 decisions.
dan: API notes: return enums in status endpoint; emit compact header: X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=soft;reason=latency;id=0xdead;ts=1700000000. Support ?dry_run=true on rollout mutate endpoints.
aj: Header must stay tiny (<=128 bytes). Use semicolon-separated lowercase k=v pairs. We'll add grammar and an OpenAPI fragment.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for autofallback-inspector by @liam  CI: https://ci.redwood/run/4999
maya: UX checklist: chip w/ tooltip, inspector drawer w/ sampled requests + 'Why' box (top 3 signals), cooldown indicator if oscillating, approver UI for protected rollouts.
liam: Cooldown pill should show remaining time and a pause button. Policy engine will surface cooldown state in status API.
sarah: Add a 'preview headers' view in the inspector so SREs can copy example X-Redwood-Fallback header for their services.
dan: I'll add decision_id into telemetry (decision_id hex) and ensure sampled=true for preview events. Also will implement dry_run=true behavior.
aj: Telemetry update: add fallback_reason enum and decision_id to v1 event docs. Keep event format flat for logs.
maya: Copy example for chip: [Soft • latency] — Quota est -4.1% (monthly). Audit preview
sarah: Also add a link from the inspector to Optimize remediation suggestions (batching, quantization).
liam: Permissions: protected rollouts require rollout-owner + ops signoff. Inspector shows required approvers and blocks commits until approved.
ops-bot: incident-bot: note: sampling spike on route 'checkout-pay' 2025-02-15T11:02Z — currently in sample-only.
dan: I'll correlate decision_id=0xdead with logs and sampled payloads.
aj: Small API note: prefer ISO timestamps in docs, but header uses epoch to keep small.
maya: Action items: liam -> UI chip + inspector drawer PR; dan -> dry_run + decision_id; aj -> docs + schema; sarah -> inspector mock; maya -> copy + signoff. Sync tomorrow 11:00 to review canary metrics. If you want canary access ping me for staging flag.
